name: Antonio Decaro - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 as regards obligations of economic operators concerning battery due diligence policies
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Commission's plan to change the EU's battery rules. The change concerns the checks companies must carry out on the batteries they make or sell, to make sure the materials in them are sourced responsibly. Parliament did not amend the proposal; it simply adopted the Commission's text as its position. The report does not spell out the details of the change itself, so it is not possible to say from this document exactly what the new obligations will be.

- Parliament backs the Commission's proposal without changes, so the existing battery due diligence rules would be adjusted as proposed.
- It affects companies that make or sell batteries in the EU and must run these checks.
- Next, Parliament and the Council negotiate the final text before it becomes law.
